csv.title: Export button only offers JSON; CSV needs a hand-typed URL
csv.summary: Program page export UI exposes only JSON even though the export endpoint also supports CSV via a query parameter.
csv.reason: This is in scope, points to a specific page and control, explains the concrete usability gap and impact, and no accepted report already covers it.

cap.title: Show how many reports I have left this week on the program page
cap.summary: Show each connected tester’s remaining weekly report quota on the program page near the File a report button.
cap.reason: This is an in-scope, specific usability request with a clear problem, proposed UI change, and benefit, and it is not the same as the accepted export-format issue.

csv-again.title: No CSV download for the queue
csv-again.summary: Program export UI lacks a CSV option even though the export endpoint supports CSV via a parameter.
csv-again.reason: This is the same issue as accepted report 16: the Export button only exposes JSON while CSV is available only through a manual URL/query parameter.

explorer.title: Explorer transaction pages take long to load
explorer.summary: Report about slow loading times on external explorer transaction pages.
explorer.reason: The issue concerns the Studio Next explorer page performance, which is explicitly excluded from scope as part of 'the GenLayer network itself, the Studio Next RPC and explorer'.

vague.title: Make the site better
vague.summary: Tester asks the site be easier and nicer to use, but gives no specific problem, step, or example.
vague.reason: The report is vague and generic with no concrete usability issue or idea, matching the LOW_EFFORT definition.

sample.title: Quickstart script says <body file> without saying what goes in it
sample.summary: Docs missing description of the body file contents and valid kind values in the quickstart script
sample.reason: The report provides clear steps, expected behavior, and actual missing information within the /docs scope, enabling the team to update the documentation.
